run_evaluation_completions: run evaluation to generate greedy text completions from a fairseq language model checkpoint
run_evaluation_singletoken: run evaluation to compute single-token prediction accuracy and corresponding targets
run_evaluation_all_modes: run full evaluation with both completion generation and single-token prediction on model checkpoints
run_evaluation_beam_search: run evaluation with configurable beam size, top-k, and top-p sampling parameters
run_evaluation_multiple_checkpoints: run evaluation across all or specific model checkpoints and save metrics to pickle files
